import sys

def main():
    x = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not x:
        return
    y = [x[0]]
    stop = False
    i = 1
    n = len(x)
    while i < n:
        # Check for "at" replacement (first occurrence only)
        if (not stop and i + 1 < n and n - i > 2 and x[i] == 'a' and x[i + 1] == 't'):
            y.append('@')
            i += 2
            stop = True
        # Check for "dot" replacement (all occurrences)
        elif (i + 1 < n and n - i > 3 and x[i] == 'd' and x[i + 1] == 'o' and i + 2 < n and x[i + 2] == 't'):
            y.append('.')
            i += 3
        else:
            y.append(x[i])
            i += 1
    print(''.join(y))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
